messages:
maria-support: Hey team — customer on Private is hitting a 401 when the collector posts the debug manifest. Collector v1.9.1 behind our mTLS gateway. Need repro steps + bundle collection. No debug bundle yet.

ojas-engineer: Can you paste the collector log lines around the upload attempt and the request_id? Also run the collector with --log-level=debug if possible.

maria-support: request_id=req_1a2b3c4d5e, local time 2026-02-18T16:12:03Z. Quick log snippet from the host: 
```
2026-02-18T16:12:03Z ERROR upload: manifest upload failed status=401 request_id=req_1a2b3c4d5e url=https://private-upload.example.net/manifests/abc123
2026-02-18T16:12:03Z DEBUG http: request headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
```

ojas-engineer: thanks — please try a curl repro from the same host (include cert flags if used). Example: 
```bash
curl -v -X PUT \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token-from-collector-config>" \
  --data-binary @manifest.json \
  "https://private-upload.example.net/manifests/abc123"\n```
This should show the server response and TLS handshake. Paste the verbose output.

collector-bot: automated: upload_attempt timestamp=2026-02-18T16:12:03Z request_id=req_1a2b3c4d5e result=401 body="{\"error\":\"unauthorized\"}"

maria-support: ran the curl without client cert: got 401. Verbose shows: 
```
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2):
* error:141A318A:SSL routines:tls_process_server_certificate:certificate verify failed
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"missing_client_cert"}
```

taylor-sre: that looks like mTLS is required by the gateway. Confirm collector config has client_cert and client_key paths set and reachable by the collector process. Try this curl variant to prove it: 
```bash
curl -v --cert /etc/collector/client.pem --key /etc/collector/client.key \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  --data-binary @manifest.json \
  "https://private-upload.example.net/manifests/abc123"\n```
If that succeeds we know the issue is cert loading or permissions.

andreia-platform: also check the presign flow: if collector requests a presign from control plane but the control plane requires client certs, presign response might be a redirect to a signed URL that the collector then uploads to. If the presign step is failing (403) we should see a different request_id from the control plane logs. Can someone grab preflight logs from the control plane around 16:11-16:13 UTC?

maria-support: I checked: presign call returns 200 and returns a signed URL, but the subsequent PUT to that signed URL fails with 401 unless the client cert is used. So gateway is enforcing mTLS for the object store endpoint too.

ojas-engineer: ok — two action items to repro and gather: 
1) From the collector host, run: 
```bash
# run collector in debug and capture upload trace
sudo systemctl stop collector && \
/usr/local/bin/collector --config /etc/collector/config.yaml --log-level debug &> /tmp/collector.debug.log &
# then run tcpdump while reproducing the upload
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host private-upload.example.net and port 443 -w /tmp/upload.pcap
```
2) Attempt curl with and without --cert to show difference. Save both verbose outputs.

collector-bot: note: debug bundle generator is available: `collector debug-bundle --output /tmp/redwood-debug.tgz --include-logs` but default redact can remove cert files. If you want the certs for debugging, run with `--no-redact` and transfer to support via secure channel.

maria-support: question: is it safe to include client cert in the debug bundle? customer policy says private certs can't leave their network. We may need to get them to upload to our support bucket via sftp.

debug-bot: FYI support upload tips: if the bundle > 80MB use sftp fallback to support-ingest.internal.example.net at path `/incoming/<org>-<ts>.tgz`. Command: 
```bash
sftp support@support-ingest.internal.example.net <<EOF
put /tmp/redwood-debug.tgz /incoming/acme-20260218.tgz
bye
EOF
```
Ensure you provide the presigned upload token to platform if requested.

taylor-sre: also run strace on the collector process during the upload to confirm it's reading the cert files: 
```bash
sudo strace -f -e trace=file -p $(pgrep -f collector) -o /tmp/collector.strace
# reproduce upload quickly, then kill strace
```
Look for open("/etc/collector/client.pem", O_RDONLY). Permissions problems (e.g., file owned by root only) are common.

andreia-platform: if customer cannot share private certs, we can request them to run these commands and paste outputs. We only need: collector.debug.log, tcpdump pcap (first 2-3MB), curl -v outputs, and collector.strace snippet showing open() to cert path. Redaction: redact token values and replace with <REDACTED_TOKEN>.

maria-support: plan set. I'll coordinate with the customer: collect the debug bundle with --no-redact (they will keep it internal), run tcpdump and strace, then attempt sftp upload to support ingest. I'll paste the curl outputs here when done — ETA 2 hours. Thanks all :thumbsup:
